native_window_feasibility.runner: Current hosted-guest-acceptance.yml uses macos-15 or macos-15-intel. No owned Chrome PID/window-ID correlation or Screen Recording preflight/authorization is established by this workflow.
native_window_feasibility.finding: Apple supports a selected-window ScreenCaptureKit filter, but its sample requires Screen Recording permission and a restart after grant. Window-list APIs can return NULL outside a GUI security session. Existing runner permission and exact owned-window correlation have not been proven with a synthetic blank window; independently owned native exposure remains unmeasured. No capture subsystem was added.
